objectives.summary: The Hitch project aims to create an online application-based service that facilitates seamless, comfortable, and safe backpack traveling. It focuses on low-cost travel options while allowing guests to choose their hosts based on user reviews and select preferred routes. The project also includes features for social events, enabling travelers to give rides and host other backpackers.
key_points: Hitch aims to make backpack traveling seamless, comfortable, and safe.
The project focuses on low-cost traveling without compromising safety and comfort.
Guests can choose their hosts based on other users' reviews.
Guests will have the option to select their preferred routes.
Hosts will receive extra reward points and can choose who to invite.

strategy.summary: The Hitch project aims to create an online application-based service that enhances the backpack traveling experience by providing features for hitching rides, hosting, and social events. The service is designed to be cost-effective, allowing travelers to utilize its features with minimal expenses, while user reviews will guide guests in selecting their hosts.
key_points: Hitch is an online application-based service aimed at making backpack traveling seamless, comfortable, and safe.
Travelers using Hitch will be able to hitch rides and utilize features like hosting and guests with almost zero dollars.
Hitch includes features for creating and joining various social events, allowing travelers to give rides and host other backpackers.

The features provided by Hitch depend on user quantities.
